body: BILL Holdings BILL has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by TPG, Inc. TPG, a global alternative asset management firm, in partnership with Corpay, Inc. CPAY. The all-cash transaction values BILL at approximately $6 billion, with shareholders set to receive $63.25 per share. The offer represents a 31% premium to BILL's 60-day volume-weighted average share price as of Nov. 16, 2026.Under the agreement, TPG will acquire a majority interest in BILL through TPG Capital, the firm’s U.S. and European private equity platform, while Corpay will acquire a minority stake. The partnership brings together TPG's technology investment and business-building experience with Corpay's expertise in payments and spend management. The companies aim to strengthen BILL's financial operations platform and expand its capabilities for small and midsize businesses.The transaction was unanimously approved by BILL's board and is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. The deal has no financing conditions attached. Following completion, BILL will become a privately held company and will no longer trade on a public stock exchange.BILL's recent financial performance provides further context for the acquisition. In the first quarter of fiscal 2027, total revenues increased 13% year over year to $353.8 million, while core revenue grew 14% to $316.4 million. The company served 475,300 businesses and processed $102 billion in payment volume, up 14% year over year. Non-GAAP operating income more than doubled to $136.9 million, reflecting improved operating efficiency.ConclusionBILL's integrated platform, growing payment volumes and improving profitability provide a solid foundation for future growth. The TPG-Corpay partnership could provide additional resources and expertise to support product innovation, AI development and long-term growth.Over the past three months, shares of this Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) company have gained 29.8% against the industry’s decline of 4%.Other Stock to ConsiderAnother top-ranked stock from the Zacks Internet Software sector is Affirm AFRM, carrying a Zacks Rank #2 at present.
